queries: WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS mesh_record_count, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_averages AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS status_ratio FROM site_ratios GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT sr.insurstat, AVG(sr.site_ratio) AS average_kept_ratio, COUNT(*) AS kept_site_count, AVG(sr.site_ratio - sa.status_ratio) AS average_excess FROM site_ratios AS sr JOIN status_averages AS sa ON sa.insurstat = sr.insurstat WHERE sr.site_ratio > sa.status_ratio GROUP BY sr.insurstat
